entries.title: Bombshell

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Bombshell is sourced as a Windows-only entry in the Bombshell series, so the Windows PC version is both the complete and highest-fidelity available route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Bombshell on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced shipped platform route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only a Windows PC release route is sourced, so there is no platform tradeoff.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or alternate edition is documented.

entries.title: Ion Fury
entries.definitive_edition: Ion Fury on Windows PC with Aftershock DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with Build-engine PC options.

primary.version: Current PC release with Aftershock DLC
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has native PC settings/capture flexibility, the Aftershock expansion route, and the broadest access to the Build-engine PC ecosystem; the console ports and Linux release do not have exclusive campaign content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Ion Fury on Steam or GOG for Windows PC, install the current build, and add Ion Fury: Aftershock for the full expansion and Arrange Mode content.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with PC settings and the Aftershock expansion DLC available.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most flexible route, with the expansion content available on the same platform.
skip: same core content family; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/settings target.

all_releases.fidelity: Console port, with Aftershock later released for PlayStation 4.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced platform-exclusive campaign content over PC; PC remains the higher-flexibility route.

all_releases.fidelity: Console port, with Aftershock later released for Xbox One and backward-compatible Xbox Series X/S play.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced platform-exclusive campaign content over PC; PC remains the higher-flexibility route.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console port, with Aftershock later released for Switch.
all_releases.reason: skip: portable route, but no sourced platform-exclusive campaign content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: With Aftershock available on PC and later consoles, the PC route remains both the highest-fidelity and complete route rather than forcing a secondary platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: Aftershock is expansion DLC with new campaign/Arrange Mode content, not a standalone game; console Aftershock support arrived later than the PC release.

entries.title: Phantom Fury

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it is the launch PC build with native PC settings/capture flexibility, while the PlayStation and Xbox releases do not have platform-exclusive story or gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Phantom Fury on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

all_releases.reason: primary: highest-flexibility fidelity/capture route and no console-exclusive content is documented.

all_releases.fidelity: PlayStation console release: a PS5 release exists, along with a PlayStation 4 release.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced platform-exclusive content over PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Xbox console release, optimized for Xbox Series X/S on the Microsoft Store, including an Xbox One/Series release.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced platform-exclusive content over PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No platform-exclusive content is documented for the console releases, so Windows PC remains the straightforward primary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expansion edition is documented.
